show_profile.broadcaster_likely: TV Tokyo (テレ東 / テレ東ダイレクト)
show_profile.program_format: Studio-based single-product deep dive with pre-recorded VTR segments, expert interviews, and live physical demonstrations.
product_lineup_observed: レイコップ コードレスUVふとんクリーナー レニー (Raycop Cordless UV Futon Cleaner Renie)
show_profile.primary_audience_profile: Housewives, families, and older adults concerned with home hygiene, allergies, and the physical strain of daily chores (e.g., sun-drying heavy futons).
show_profile.typical_episode_length_estimate: Likely a 10-15 minute segment within a larger lifestyle/shopping show block, given the precise timings like '1m 30s VTR' and '15s Telephone Attack'.
show_profile.tonal_register: Highly enthusiastic, empathetic to daily struggles, authoritative on technology and health, and urgently compelling during the pitch.
trust_devices: Scientific Data (Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology test results)
Massive Social Proof (8 million units sold across 20+ countries)
Brand Recognition ('When you think of futon cleaners, you think of Raycop')
High-contrast visual proof demonstrations (dirt on black paper)

act_breakdown.act: The Hook & Problem Setup (アバン / VTR)
act_breakdown.purpose: Agitate a hidden problem the viewer didn't realize they had (e.g., dust mites surviving sun-drying).
common_opening_lines_jp: あなたの睡眠に欠かせない毎日使う寝具・・・実はダニ由来のハウスダストが潜んでいるかもしれません！

act_breakdown.purpose: Establish product credibility and reveal the new iteration's physical advantages.
key_beats: Show previous heavy/famous model to anchor brand trust
MCs confirm they know the brand
Surprise reveal of the new, different-looking, lightweight model
Physical interaction (MCs hold it and react to the weight)
common_opening_lines_jp: みなさん、布団クリーナーと言えば、こちら！一度は見たことがありませんか？
ですが、本日ご紹介するのはこのタイプではないんです。
common_closing_lines_jp: 従来品と持ち比べてみていかがですか？

act_breakdown.act: The Live Demonstrations (スタジオ② / ③)
act_breakdown.purpose: Provide undeniable visual proof of the product's claims (suction power, ease of use).
key_beats: Setup an extreme test (powder under a sheet)
MC performs the test to prove ease of use
The 'Reveal' (pulling back the sheet / dumping dirt on black paper)
Explanation of the tech behind the result (brushes, motor, UV)
common_opening_lines_jp: その実力、ぜひ試していただきましょう！
本当にキレイに吸えます〜？！
common_closing_lines_jp: やっぱり叩きながら吸うっていう事が大切なんですよ。

act_breakdown.purpose: Address viewer doubts (battery life, storage, maintenance) before the price drop.
common_opening_lines_jp: でもコードレスってすぐ充電切れになるイメージありません？
ご安心ください！1回の充電で標準モードおよそ30分！
common_closing_lines_jp: あとはお値段だけですね。お願いします！

act_breakdown.act: The Offer & CTA (価格発表 / テレホンアタック)
act_breakdown.purpose: Overwhelm the viewer with value, drop the price dramatically, and trigger immediate purchase.
key_beats: Add bonus item 2 (with its monetary value)
Drop to the final discounted price ('Price stays the same!')
common_opening_lines_jp: メーカー直販価格 19,800 円のところ、税込み 14,800 円なんですが、今回は特別に...
common_closing_lines_jp: お値段そのまま、税込み 14,800 円でのご提供です！

act_breakdown.purpose: Provide real-world social proof to push on-the-fence buyers.
key_beats: Homeowner claims their house is clean
Homeowner is shocked by how much dirt is collected
common_opening_lines_jp: その実力を片岡さんのお宅で試させて頂くことに！

scene_to_scene_transitions: VTR to Studio: Often abrupt, cutting from a high-tension question ('What should we do?!') directly to the live studio hosts.
Studio to Demo: Guided by the Product Advisor physically walking the MCs to a distinct set piece (indicated by '■スタジオ②').
Feature to Price: A direct handoff from the MC expressing desire ('Now we just need the price!') to the Advisor or Narrator launching the pitch.
macro_structure.narrative_arc_summary: The segment moves from invisible terror (dust mites causing allergies) to physical relief (lightweight, easy-to-use cordless vacuum), proven by dramatic visual evidence (black paper/sheet tests), culminating in an irresistible stacked-value financial offer.

speaker_roles.function: Drives the VTR segments, sets up the stakes, explains complex technical specs rapidly, and delivers the hard-sell price pitches.
voice_traits: Dramatic and urgent during price reveals
signature_phrases_jp: 布団クリーナーと言えば「レイコップ」
早速見ていきましょう！
signature_phrases_en: When you think of futon cleaners, you think of 'Raycop'.
What on earth should we do?!
Let's take a look right away!
speaker_roles.interaction_with_other_roles: Functions as the Voice of God over VTRs and CTAs; rarely interacts directly with live studio hosts.

speaker_roles.function: The brand representative. Introduces the product, guides the MCs through demonstrations, answers objections, and reveals the price.
signature_phrases_jp: その実力、ぜひ試していただきましょう！
signature_phrases_en: Let's have you test its power!
speaker_roles.interaction_with_other_roles: Acts as the host/teacher to the MCs, prompting them to try the product and setting them up for their reactions.

speaker_roles.role: 山内・小島 (Yamauchi & Kojima / MCs / Reaction Talent)
speaker_roles.function: Audience surrogates. They express the doubts, ask the questions, and provide the exaggerated amazement the home viewer is expected to feel.
signature_phrases_jp: うそ、こんなに取れるの！？
今すぐ家に帰って掃除したい！
signature_phrases_en: No way, it picked up this much?!
I want to go home right now and clean!
speaker_roles.interaction_with_other_roles: Follows the Advisor's lead, interacts physically with the product, and reacts to the Narrator/Advisor's reveals.

speaker_roles.function: Provides relatable, third-party social proof in VTR segments.
signature_phrases_jp: 多分そんなに汚れてないんじゃないかな？？
signature_phrases_en: It's probably not that dirty, right??
speaker_roles.interaction_with_other_roles: Responds to off-camera producer questions; reacts privately to the product's performance.

writing_style_dna.honorific_register: A mix of standard polite 'Teineigo' (です/ます - desu/masu) from the Narrator and Advisor, contrasted with casual, emotive speech from the MCs and Customers.
sentence_rhythms: Staccato bursts during tech specs (ファブリックブラシと…フィンパンチブラシで…たたき出します！)
Long, stacking, breathless run-on sentences during the price reveal.
rhetorical_devices: Rhetorical Questions: 'Is it really suctioning properly?' (ちゃんと吸引できてるんですかね？)
Hyperbole: 'I want to go home right now and clean!' (今すぐ家に帰って掃除したい！)
Contrast: 'Compact body, powerful suction' (コンパクトボディながらパワフルな吸引力)
lexical_patterns: Heavy use of '〜させていただきます' (humble action verbs).
Action verbs emphasizing power: たたき出す (knock out), かき出す (scrape out), 吸引する (suction).
filler_and_transition_phrases_jp: ではさっそく (Then right away)
number_and_metric_patterns: Extremely specific numbers to build trust: 79,200回 (79,200 times), 99.9%除去 (99.9% removal).
Sales milestones: 累計800万台突破 (Cumulative 8 million units surpassed).
emphasis_techniques: Exclamation marks are used on almost every definitive statement or reaction.
Visual emphasis using '●' and '○' markers in the script to tie specific words to on-screen text.
humor_and_warmth_techniques: Self-deprecation regarding household chores ('I never clean my curtains...').
Playful horror at how dirty one's own bed is ('Eek! Too scary!').
writing_style_dna.kana_kanji_balance_notes: Accessible reading level. Technical terms are clearly spelled out in Katakana (ファブリックブラシ), while complex concepts are simplified into easy-to-read phrases (叩き吸い - pounding and sucking).

hook_templates: You do [Common Habit], but did you know [Invisible Threat] is still there?!
When you think of [Product Category], you think of [Brand], right? Well look at this!
problem_framing_patterns: The 'Hidden Danger': Dust mites cause allergies and survive normal sun-drying.
The 'Chore Burden': Normal vacuums are heavy, corded, and annoying to use.
demonstration_patterns: The Barrier Test: Vacuuming powder *through* a thick sheet to prove suction depth.
The High-Contrast Reveal: Emptying collected white dust onto a stark black piece of paper.
social_proof_patterns: Global sales numbers (8 million units in 20+ countries).
Real-home VTR tests showing a skeptical customer being proven wrong.
authority_signal_patterns: Interviewing a titled expert (Representative Director of Environmental Allergens).
Quoting clinical research data (Guangzhou Institute of Microbiology) in footnotes.
objection_handling_patterns: Objection: Cordless means weak battery. -> Rebuttal: High-quality BLDC motor + 30 mins runtime.
Objection: I don't want to buy expensive filters. -> Rebuttal: We are including 45 disposable filters for free.
Objection: It takes up space. -> Rebuttal: It is compact and stands on its own.
urgency_patterns: 今回は特別に (This time, specially...)
Telephone Attack graphic segments prompting immediate calls.
price_reveal_patterns: The Value Stack: State base price. Add Bonus A. Add Bonus B. State total retail value. Drop to final price ('お値段そのまま' - Price stays the same!).
bundle_and_bonus_patterns: Include a ridiculous amount of consumables to remove long-term cost objections (e.g., 45 disposable filters total).
guarantee_patterns: The brand name itself acts as a guarantee ('その実力は折り紙付きです！' - Its capabilities are guaranteed because it's Raycop!).
closing_and_cta_patterns: Hard cut to a 15-25 second graphical 'Telephone Attack' displaying numbers and urgency timers.

common_diagram_types: Overhead studio floor plans indicating where hosts (represented by smiley faces) and props (stands, sofas) are positioned.
on_screen_text_conventions: Indicated in script by '○' or '●' or 'テロップ'.
Disclaimers are mandatory and exact (e.g., '※効果を保証するものではありません' - Not a guarantee of effectiveness).
Price and bundled numbers must match the audio exactly.
camera_or_demo_cues: 1S: One-shot (close up on product or face).
2S: Two-shot (capturing the interaction between two hosts).
インサート (Insert): B-roll footage cutting away from the live studio to show tech animations or usage.
早送り想定 (Fast-forward assumed): Direction to speed up boring parts of a demo in post/live-playback.
music_and_sfx_vocabulary: Implied through high-energy formatting, but explicit audio cues (BGM/SE) are largely omitted from this specific document, relying instead on timing markers.

annotation_conventions: Left column handles all visual cues, timing (e.g., '1s', '2s'), camera shots (1S, 2S), and telop texts.
Right column handles speaker tags and dialogue.
Handwritten arrows link specific dialogue lines to camera moves or physical actions (e.g., 'Take out trash -> (arrow down)').
Hatched lines (////) in the middle column indicate a continuation of the current camera shot.
color_or_highlight_usage: Gray shading on alternating rows in some tables to separate speaker lines.
Dark headers indicating Studio changes (e.g., '■スタジオ②').
page_layout_conventions.page_to_segment_mapping_notes: Each page generally covers one distinct 'beat' or demonstration setup. Timing is tightly controlled down to the second.

for_each_section.intent: To make the final price seem like an impossible bargain by front-loading the retail value of the product and its bonuses.
must_include: Introduction of Bonus 2 with its specific retail value
The 'Price Stays the Same' final reveal
style_rules: Narrator or Advisor must speak rapidly but with intense emphasis on the numbers.
Must use the phrase 'ところ' (instead of) to pivot from high to low price.
example_lines_jp: メーカー直販価格19,800円のところ、税込み14,800円なんですが、今回は特別に…
合計45枚の使い捨てフィルターをセットにして…
お値段そのまま、税込み14,800円でのご提供です！
example_lines_en: Instead of the direct retail price of 19,800 yen, it's 14,800 yen, but this time specially...
Setting it up with a total of 45 disposable filters...
The price stays the same, offered at 14,800 yen including tax!
for_each_section.typical_visual_or_demo: Graphic telop building the 'stack' block by block, ending with a massive, bold red number for the final price.

global_style_rules: Always include enthusiastic, conversational reactions from MCs to break up technical explanations.
Every major product claim must be backed by either a live visual demonstration or expert/clinical data.
Address potential negative objections explicitly before asking for the sale.
do_not_do: Do not have the Narrator casually chat with the MCs; keep roles strictly defined.
Do not reveal the final price before fully explaining the bonuses.
Do not forget to include disclaimers (e.g., '※個人の感想です') when showing testimonials or clinical data.

evidence_index.claim: The show uses an Environmental Allergen Expert to validate the hidden danger of dust mites.
Live demonstrations use high-contrast visuals, such as vacuuming powder through a sheet or dumping white dust onto black paper.
The price reveal uses a 'value stacking' technique, bundling 45 extra filters to inflate the original retail value before dropping the price.
MCs utilize hyperbole and highly expressive onomatopoeia to react to the product.
Specific numerical metrics (79,200 taps, 99.9% removal, 30 minutes battery) are repeatedly cited to build technical trust.
